Interface RolledNode<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the children
All Known Implementing Classes:
RolledNode.Arithmetic, RolledNode.Bound, RolledNode.Comparison, RolledNode.Constant, RolledNode.Dice, RolledNode.Extremum, RolledNode.Group, RolledNode.Negate, RolledNode.Repeat
public sealed interface RolledNode<T> permits RolledNode.Constant<T>, RolledNode.Bound<T>, RolledNode.Dice<T>, RolledNode.Extremum<T>, RolledNode.Repeat<T>, RolledNode.Negate<T>, RolledNode.Arithmetic<T>, RolledNode.Comparison<T>, RolledNode.Group<T>
One node of a RolledExpression, whose children are of type T: a DiceNode together with what it evaluated to.

In RolledExpression.node(), the children are rolled expressions themselves. In the function passed to RolledExpression.fold(Function), they are what that function returned for them.

Since:
0.2.0
